title: Kamer historian lab
corpus: Dutch Parliamentary Proceedings 1814–2012 (PoliticalMashup / Marx et al.), doi:10.17026/DANS-XK5-DW3S, CC0. Working slice 1814–1899.

tasks.rank: Blind pairwise ranking of pause-and-interview answers given off the floor (wandelgang / side room), not as Tweede Kamer speeches. They should not open by addressing the Chair. Rate believability (could this public person have said this, in late-1890s Dutch?) and historical-procedural plausibility (does it respect the Reglement van Orde?). Conditions are hidden. Two items are attention checks.
tasks.speakers: Check names, roles, and parties parsed from OCR'd Handelingen XML. Mark garbled readings. Flag synthetic or invented cards. We do not ask you to reconstruct private lives.
tasks.procedure: For each clip or vignette: would the Chair have allowed it, and would the stenographer have written it into the Handelingen?

ethics: Agents are public office-holders. There is no playable persona. Do not invent inner lives. Annotations are research data; download your JSON and send it back to the investigators.
